first.rationale: Activation and onboarding are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve early activation. Verifying both records will clarify whether the effects were durable and whether simplification risks lowering lead quality or downstream qualified revenue. A small guarded test is preferable to broad pricing action because the primary objective is sustainable qualified revenue, not only short-term acquisition.

final.rationale: Run a randomized, segment-aware test of shortened onboarding this week. The verified record directly addresses the current onboarding decline and shows improved completion, faster time-to-value, and higher 30-day retention, making it the strongest path to sustainable qualified revenue. Signup simplification also improved SMB activation but reduced retention by 1%, so preserve that uncertainty and use activation, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention guardrails rather than broadly reducing signup friction. Analyze SMB separately and avoid generalizing the signup result beyond SMB.
